Bot.ShortDescription: Sign-ups for pub quiz nights: one roster your team owns, with a reserve list that manages itself.
Bot.Description:
Quizr runs sign-ups for your quiz nights — buttons instead of message reactions, with a roster the bot owns.

Add it to your team's group chat and make it an admin. A captain posts a game, everyone else taps to join. The first players fill the seats and the rest form a reserve that promotes automatically when someone drops out. Guests take seats too.

One pinned message lists every upcoming game and how full it is.

Available in English, Russian and German.
Start.Greeting: Hi! I'm Quizr — I run sign-ups for your quiz nights.
Help.Intro: Quizr runs sign-ups for your quiz nights — buttons instead of message reactions, with a real roster, a reserve queue, guests, and reminders. Most of what the bot does happens through buttons on a game's announcement: joining, bringing a guest, dropping out, declining, finishing. These commands are for setup and configuration.
Help.Repo: Quizr is open source. Bug reports, ideas and pull requests are welcome: {Url}
Setup.Welcome: Thanks for adding me! I've set the group language to {Locale}. Before I can schedule games, a captain needs to set the team's timezone: send /settimezone with an IANA id, e.g. /settimezone Europe/Berlin. Send /help any time for the full list of commands.
Setup.NotAdmin: I'm not an admin here yet. Please make me one — I need it to pin the board and to see who joins or leaves.
Setup.TimeZoneSet: Timezone set to {TimeZoneId}. Games created from now on will use it.
Setup.TimeZoneInvalid: "{Input}" isn't a timezone I recognise. Use an IANA id, e.g. Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.
Setup.LanguageSet: Language set to {Locale}. Group messages will use it from now on.
Setup.MyLanguageSet: Got it — I'll use {Locale} for your DMs from now on.
Setup.LanguageInvalid: "{Input}" isn't a language I support. Choose one of: en, ru, de.
Setup.RemindersUsage: Reply with three times, in order: evening-before time, morning-of time, and how long before kickoff to remind. Use HH:mm for each, e.g. /setreminders 20:00 09:00 02:00
Setup.RemindersSet: Reminders updated: evening before at {EveningBeforeAt:HH\:mm}, morning of at {MorningOfAt:HH\:mm}, {BeforeStartLead:hh\:mm} before kickoff.
NewGame.NeedsTimeZone: This team doesn't have a timezone set yet. A captain should run /settimezone first.
NewGame.NotCaptain: Only a captain can do that.

Franchise.AskCapacity: How many players fit? Reply with a number, or "skip" if it varies.
